scope: Anywhere in view; glass bottle of an alcoholic drink.

text.criterion: A glass bottle of an alcoholic drink, such as liquor, spirits, wine or beer, typically with a printed brand label, is clearly visible.
text.counter_examples: Plain water bottles, soft-drink or plastic bottles, flasks, thermoses, cups and other non-alcoholic containers do not count.

status.note: Experimental preset, not validated: no accuracy claim. On the internal knife check every real knife was missed at gate 0.95.
